canonical.fingerprintAlgorithm: FNV-1a 32-bit over NFKD/lowercase/punctuation-insensitive normalized text; stem hash over normalized stem; option hash over sorted normalized options joined by spaces; answer hash over normalized correct option; topic hash over normalized topic; concept hash over normalized category, topic and sorted non-stopword stem tokens; w contains sorted token hashes.

currentNormalizedScan.normalization: NFKD, lowercase, punctuation-insensitive alphanumeric stems; option sets sorted order-insensitively

candidateScan.method: Exact FNV-1a normalized-stem and sorted-option fingerprints; punctuation/case/diacritic-insensitive normalization; option-insensitive comparisons; token-Jaccard screening against all official PYQ text; pairwise within-batch screening; manual semantic review of closest matches, topic overlap, calculations and learning objectives. Option-only fingerprint hits were separately inspected and are not counted as duplicate questions without a matching stem or semantic concept.
